Preserve exactly the unmirrored Idle master's asymmetrical identity: the same mask crack topology/blue slit side, each original hand and armor plate on its original anatomical side, original upper-left rear cloth bundle attachment and original lower-right long cloth attachment, cold silver icy cloth, dark faceted armor, original light from upper-left. The rear bundle can bend across behind the head with wind but MUST stay rooted to its original screen-left shoulder, never change anatomical sides. Draw actual articulated LEFTWARD MOVEMENT while the creature still faces the viewer. Do NOT horizontally flip a right-moving picture, do not mirror the mask, armor, hands, cloth attachment points or lighting. Body leans toward SCREEN LEFT, trailing loose cloth streams SCREEN RIGHT. No added ornaments, eyes, limbs, extra fingers, attack orb, slashing effects, floor shadow, fog, detached sparks. Existing wrist and mask blue light only. Identical physical scale to master: narrow mask about95px tall on1024 canvas, same collar, torso, arm lengths. All cloth and faint alpha must lie within x=105..915, y=100..925, leaving safety padding. Do not crop or shrink the body to fit; curl cloth tips within bounds. Output a single full-body sprite with crisp painted icy fabric and high fidelity to the supplied approved master. Frame04, the first stable left movement bank. Hands follow with mild inertial spread, still hanging lower than shoulders.
